steps.content: [Background - Outside Refugee Camp]
Soon, a silhouette that doesn't belong to the desert appears on the distant horizon.

As the sand ship draws nearer, the platinum-colored buildings sharpen into view, their towering spires ablaze with golden light. Beneath this gleaming skyline, clusters of small, dark dwellings cling together like shadows.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's... Fraser?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: To clarify, this is merely a research facility on the outskirts of Fraser. The actual city is still a hundred kilometers away.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Luminaris Society</color>—Fraser's foremost academic institution established this facility as their primary Aurum Secretum research center. Most simply refer to it as the Aurum Secretum Research Institute.
A head suddenly pops up beside Hella, its owner cutting in with a mischievous grin.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, it's practically exile. While all the proper noble lords are wining and dining in the city, only our saintly Lady Hypa would graciously stoop to visit such a wretched place... and mingle with the likes of us.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We're pretty much neighbors with other farland cities here. When disasters strike, those poor doomed souls have nowhere to flee but our hospitable doorstep. You see those sprawling settlements? Don't mistake them for some rustic countryside—

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: That's a sea of <color=#fb9259>refugee camps</color>.

The vessel glides past a low hill, its course steadily drawing it toward the sprawling complex of structures ahead. From the deck of the sand ship, Hella surveys the makeshift camps lining the path—clusters of tents and rickety bungalows made of wooden planks strewn across the land.
As the ship drifts by, the refugees raise their heads in slow, mechanical unison. Their hollow eyes, dull with exhaustion, betray no spark of hope.
Beneath their sun-scorched faces, their bodies tell the same story—wracked by hunger, sickness, and the relentless toll of survival.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: All these people crowded outside the city... Don't the people inside do anything about it?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, they do. The institute hands out meals and beds like charity, and even special care for the poor, infected folks. Honestly? They're living like kings compared to the wretches wandering in the WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Get cured, and who knows? They might even earn a shiny little job at the institute and become true Fraser citizens—imagine that! A real life of comfort and prosperity!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Out there, with all those disasters and bandits, it's just pure survival. But here? Fraser welcomes them, gives them a shelter, and even plays "doctor"...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: For them, isn't this a land of hope after all?
The next moment, as if recognizing someone on the deck, a wave of joyous commotion erupts among the refugees.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: ...Synex? That's Synex!

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Synex is back! Our <color=#fb9259>hero</color> has returned!
They shout and cheer, surging toward the path's edge, arms outstretched toward Synex above.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Synex! Bless me—I want to be chosen next time!

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: Go, Synex! I-I'll work hard too! One day... I'll be an Aurum Secretum Warrior, just like you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What... what's going on here?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Didn't I just tell you? Lucky refugees might even secure a job at the institute and live a real life of comfort and prosperity.
With a sweeping gesture, Synex commands the air—Aurum Secretum spills from her, trailing her movements in a radiant arc of gold. The refugees' frenzy intensifies, their voices rising in fervor.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: After treatment, some are able to resonate with Aurum Secretum, becoming <color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum Warriors</color> who serve Fraser...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And I just happen to be the luckiest one of them all.
[Scene Transition - Fraser Institute Exterior]
In mere minutes, the sand ship glides past the bustling refugee camp and grinds to a halt before the institute's plaza.
A group of white-coated researchers stands waiting, led by a young man who barely has time to open his mouth—before Synex crashes into him with a gleeful tackle.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Little Saffar! It's been so long!
Before the young man can react, Synex seizes him by the hair and gives it a rough, playful tousle.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...Let go of me!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hahaha, don't be shy! Everyone, this is Saffar, an Aurum Secretum Warrior just like me. Though someone decided he's too capable... so now they stick him with paperwork, reception, and all those thrilling little chores—

The young man wrenches free from Synex's grasp at last. As he raises his hand, Hella's keen gaze locks onto the faint shimmer of Aurum Secretum particles escaping from between his fingers and sleeve. There's no doubt now—his power mirrors Synex's own.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...I sincerely apologize for my unprofessional behavior in front of you all.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: As mentioned, I'm Saffar, assistant to Director Hermis of the Aurum Secretum Research Institute here.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Following Mr. Adelaide's instructions, we've prepared guest rooms and meals for all of you. However, before that... the director has requested a meeting with the two distinguished guests from DisCity.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Just us? What about Hypatia?
Saffar offers Hypatia a respectful, slight bow.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Mr. Adelaide hopes you'll return home at your earliest convenience, and the Senate is eager to hear your report. That said, please don't concern yourself with Furor's residents. We've already arranged full medical support for them, and their recovery will be well underway.
Hella opens her mouth to speak, but Hypatia cuts her off with a silent gesture.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Very well. If those are my brother's wishes, I shall comply.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But we haven't even—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Don't worry, I haven't forgotten our agreement. Once my affairs are settled, I'll come back to you.
Hella blinks, reading Hypatia's gaze in an instant—the plan has changed. They'll have to split up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hypatia... you're really going back alone?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's just that Fraser is quite far away, and the communications would be difficult, so I prepared a parting gift for you.
She opens her palm, letting an exquisitely crafted Aurum Secretum communication device slip into Hella's hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is... for me?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I broke the little doll you saw before, so I made a new one.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is an Aurum Secretum communicator. Barring targeted interference, it can technically maintain stable one-to-one contact even across the distance to DisCity.
Hella examines the communicator, eyes gleaming with excitement as she rotates it between her fingers.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hey now, no need to get so worked up. MBCC has plenty of these, right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I only got to hold these when on field missions with ${PlayerName}, and he'd be all like "Phones rot your brain, kid!" and snatch it back the second we finished! This is literally MY first communicator ever!
steps.female_content: I only got to hold these when on field missions with ${PlayerName}, and she'd be all like "Phones rot your brain, kid!" and snatch it back the second we finished! This is literally MY first communicator ever!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, and it's not just any communicator—it's a souped-up special edition! Now I can spam people with messages even when I'm knee-deep in the field!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm glad you like it. If you run into any problems, just send me a message.
The sandship's horn echoes once more as Hypatia takes her leave. After the farewells, only a single person stands unassigned.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: How sweeeet! Not even I've gotten gifts from the young lady. Someone's getting special treatment—

It is hard to tell how much sincerity there is in Synex's voice. Hella presses her lips together, poised to retort, only to find Synex already striding toward the colossal Aurum Secretum cage that imprisons the Apostle.
Before Hella can process her actions, the white-robed young man walks up, motioning for them to follow.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Synex is the most exceptional Aurum Secretum Warrior. She'll be overseeing the Apostle of Ashes' transfer to the detention facility.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: For you both, the Director is expecting your arrival. If you'd please follow me.
